title: Grade 4 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Mock Exam #8

pages.quiz:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #8
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which choice affects other people besides yourself? (1 mark)
   A. Littering the school compound
   B. Choosing which shoe to wear first
   C. Choosing a song you like
   D. Choosing your favourite colour

2. Why is it important to know your family members? (1 mark)
   A. So you can avoid them
   B. It helps you to greet them and understand how you are related
   C. So you can boast
   D. So you can forget them

3. Whom should you tell if someone touches you in a wrong way? (1 mark)
   A. The person who touched you
   B. A stranger
   C. A trusted adult such as a parent or teacher
   D. Nobody

4. Which parts of the body are private? (1 mark)
   A. The face
   B. The parts covered by underwear or a swimming costume
   C. The hands
   D. The feet

5. Which New Testament book tells how the early church began? (1 mark)
   A. Acts
   B. Luke
   C. Hebrews
   D. Romans

6. How many books are in the New Testament? (1 mark)
   A. 39
   B. 27
   C. 66
   D. 21

7. Which people did Balak want Balaam to curse? (1 mark)
   A. The Egyptians
   B. The Philistines
   C. The Israelites
   D. The Romans

8. What did the donkey see on the road? (1 mark)
   A. A wall
   B. The angel of the Lord
   C. A lion
   D. A snake

9. Which verse says that all peoples on earth will be blessed through Abraham? (1 mark)
   A. Genesis 12:3
   B. Genesis 1:1
   C. Luke 1:37
   D. John 3:16

10. Where did Abram live before going to Canaan? (1 mark)
   A. Bethlehem
   B. Egypt
   C. Rome
   D. Haran

11. Who would come upon Mary so that she could conceive? (1 mark)
   A. The Holy Spirit
   B. Elizabeth
   C. Joseph
   D. An angel

12. Where was Zechariah when the angel appeared to him? (1 mark)
   A. By the river
   B. On a mountain
   C. At home
   D. In the temple

13. Which angel appeared to Zechariah? (1 mark)
   A. Gabriel
   B. Uriel
   C. Michael
   D. Raphael

14. Which of these is a result of revenge? (1 mark)
   A. The problem gets bigger
   B. Everyone is safe
   C. Peace grows
   D. Friendship grows

15. According to the Lord's Prayer, we ask God to forgive us as we: (1 mark)
   A. Forget others
   B. Punish others
   C. Forgive others
   D. Ignore others

16. What does it mean to trust someone? (1 mark)
   A. To believe they are honest and will not harm you
   B. To fear them
   C. To argue with them
   D. To hide from them

17. A stranger offers you a lift. What should you do? (1 mark)
   A. Say no and tell a trusted adult
   B. Accept
   C. Go with them
   D. Give your name

18. What is one result of lying? (1 mark)
   A. Peace of mind
   B. Better marks
   C. More friends
   D. Loss of trust

19. Which of these helps us to overcome lying? (1 mark)
   A. Blaming others
   B. Exaggerating
   C. Hiding things
   D. Admitting mistakes quickly

20. What did Jesus do to the children? (1 mark)
   A. Ignored them
   B. Gave them money
   C. Sent them home
   D. Placed His hands on them and blessed them

21. Which is a way of keeping a uniform in good condition? (1 mark)
   A. Tearing it
   B. Lending it out
   C. Washing and mending it
   D. Leaving it in mud

22. What are the two meanings of the word church? (1 mark)
   A. A river and a hill
   B. A song and a prayer
   C. A market and a school
   D. The building and the people of God

23. What did Jesus say the temple should be called? (1 mark)
   A. A palace
   B. A market
   C. A school
   D. A house of prayer

24. What does Acts 2:38 tell people to do? (1 mark)
   A. Repent and be baptised
   B. Sell everything
   C. Stay at home
   D. Fast for a month

25. About how many people were baptised that day? (1 mark)
   A. Thirty
   B. Three hundred
   C. Three thousand
   D. Three

26. What should you do if a group invites you to do something wrong? (1 mark)
   A. Keep it secret
   B. Say no, walk away and tell a trusted adult
   C. Ask for more
   D. Join in

27. What does "Give us today our daily bread" mean? (1 mark)
   A. We ask God for what we need each day
   B. We ask for gold
   C. We ask for a party
   D. We ask for money

28. What does "hallowed" mean? (1 mark)
   A. Old
   B. Rich
   C. Holy
   D. Loud

29. What does integrity mean when using a phone? (1 mark)
   A. Hiding things
   B. Copying others
   C. Doing right when nobody is watching
   D. Wasting data

30. Which of these should you not share? (1 mark)
   A. A Bible verse
   B. Private pictures of yourself
   C. A gospel song
   D. A school notice

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Explain how a child can show appreciation for God's blessings, using what you learned about Abraham. (5 marks)

32. Explain why God changed Abram's name to Abraham. (3 marks)

33. Explain the lessons that we learn from Matthew 21:12-14. (5 marks)

34. Explain why Christians should show the fruit of the Holy Spirit. (3 marks)

35. Why were people with leprosy kept apart in Bible times? (2 marks)

36. Explain what the parts of the parable stand for. (3 marks)

37. Name two digital devices used at home or school. (2 marks)

38. Name two ways of expressing thanks to people who are kind to us. (2 marks)

39. Give three ways of living a righteous life. (3 marks)

40. Give two lessons from the story of Balaam and his donkey. (2 marks)

41. Explain how a child can show faith in God when they or a family member is sick. (5 marks)

42. Give three ways of obeying God in daily life. (3 marks)

43. State two things the angel said about John before he was born. (2 marks)

44. Explain how children can help the needy at school, at home and in church. (5 marks)

45. State two lessons from Joseph's response to temptation. (2 marks)

46. State three rules for safe use of social media. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #8 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — Littering the school compound
   Littering makes the compound dirty for everyone.

2. B — It helps you to greet them and understand how you are related
   Knowing family helps in respect and relationships.

3. C — A trusted adult such as a parent or teacher
   A trusted adult can protect you.

4. B — The parts covered by underwear or a swimming costume
   Private parts are those covered by underwear.

5. A — Acts
   The Acts of the Apostles tells the story of the early church.

6. B — 27
   The New Testament has 27 books.

7. C — The Israelites
   Balak feared the Israelites camped on the plains of Moab.

8. B — The angel of the Lord
   The angel stood in the road with a drawn sword.

9. A — Genesis 12:3
   Genesis 12:3 contains this promise.

10. D — Haran
   Terah's family settled in Haran.

11. A — The Holy Spirit
   Luke 1:35 says the Holy Spirit would come on her.

12. D — In the temple
   He was burning incense in the temple.

13. A — Gabriel
   Gabriel said, "I stand in the presence of God."

14. A — The problem gets bigger
   Revenge starts a cycle of hurting.

15. C — Forgive others
   The prayer links our forgiveness with forgiving others.

16. A — To believe they are honest and will not harm you
   Trust means believing someone is reliable.

17. A — Say no and tell a trusted adult
   Never go with strangers.

18. D — Loss of trust
   People stop trusting a liar.

19. D — Admitting mistakes quickly
   Admitting mistakes builds truthfulness.

20. D — Placed His hands on them and blessed them
   Matthew 19:15 says He blessed them.

21. C — Washing and mending it
   Good care extends its life.

22. D — The building and the people of God
   Church means the building and the community.

23. D — A house of prayer
   Matthew 21:13 says, "My house will be called a house of prayer."

24. A — Repent and be baptised
   Peter's answer to the crowd.

25. C — Three thousand
   Acts 2:41.

26. B — Say no, walk away and tell a trusted adult
   Refuse and seek help.

27. A — We ask God for what we need each day
   It refers to daily needs.

28. C — Holy
   Hallowed be your name means may your name be honoured as holy.

29. C — Doing right when nobody is watching
   Integrity is honesty in private.

30. B — Private pictures of yourself
   Never share private pictures.

SECTION B
----
31. (5 marks)
   Answer: Abraham received God's blessings and passed them on. A child can thank God in prayer for family, food, health and school, share with others, obey God, and be a blessing as Abraham was told to be.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for blessings to Abraham, 1 for thanking God, 1 for examples of blessings, 1 for sharing, 1 for obeying or being a blessing.

32. (3 marks)
   Answer: God made a covenant with him and promised that he would be a father of many nations. The new name reminded him of this promise.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the covenant, 1 for the promise, 1 for the name as a reminder.

33. (5 marks)
   Answer: The house of God is holy; it is for prayer; we must not misuse it or cheat others; Jesus cares about what happens there; it is a place of healing and help.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid lesson up to 5.

34. (3 marks)
   Answer: It pleases God, makes us like Jesus, and helps us to live well with others.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each reason.

35. (2 marks)
   Answer: The disease was contagious and people feared it would spread.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for disease and 1 for fear of spread.

36. (3 marks)
   Answer: The woman stands for God; the coin stands for a lost person; the joy stands for the joy in heaven when someone repents.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid part.

37. (2 marks)
   Answer: Phone, tablet, computer, TV, radio.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

38. (2 marks)
   Answer: Say thank you, write a card, help them in return.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid way.

39. (3 marks)
   Answer: Tell the truth, obey parents, share, avoid bad company, say sorry, pray and read the Bible.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid way.

40. (2 marks)
   Answer: Obey God; do not be greedy; bless others; be kind to animals. Any two.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid lesson.

41. (5 marks)
   Answer: Pray, believe that God cares, ask trusted adults, go to a clinic or hospital for treatment, thank God for help, and continue to trust. Faith does not mean ignoring doctors.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for prayer, 1 for belief in God's care, 1 for seeking treatment, 1 for thanks, 1 for continuing to trust.

42. (3 marks)
   Answer: Obey parents and teachers, read and follow the Bible, tell the truth, pray, be kind.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid way.

43. (2 marks)
   Answer: He would bring joy, be great before the Lord, be filled with the Holy Spirit, and turn many to God. Any two.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid point.

44. (5 marks)
   Answer: School: share a pencil or lunch, help a struggling classmate. Home: help with chores, give clothes that still fit. Church: take part in collections, visit the sick with parents.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of school, home and church, and 2 marks for clear explanations.

45. (2 marks)
   Answer: Say no clearly, run away, remember that sin is against God, stay faithful.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each lesson.

46. (3 marks)
   Answer: Ask permission, do not chat with strangers, do not share personal details, be kind, limit time.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each rule.
